reason: A web-profile chat enhancement that lets users Ctrl-click recognized file paths to open their containing folders and URLs to open new browser tabs.

summaries.zh: 在聊天消息中识别文件路径和网址，让用户通过 Ctrl+点击打开文件所在文件夹或在新浏览器标签页中打开链接。
summaries.en: Recognizes file paths and URLs in chat messages so users can Ctrl-click to open containing folders or launch links in new browser tabs.

capabilities: Recognizes file paths and URLs in rendered chat messages
Resolves relative paths against the session workspace or harness working directory
Opens containing folders in the operating system file manager
Opens URLs in a new browser tab
Checks whether referenced paths exist before opening them
